defect: For an ignored member the non-public flag is combined with &= instead of |=, so it can never become true there and ignored non-public members no longer count towards serializing non-public members.
why: The flag starts false, so &= leaves it false; later members are then treated as if no non-public member is serialized, changing which unkeyed members are reported and generated. This is an unrequested change next to the fix (N2).
